Definition: from G129 and a derivative of G1632; an effusion of blood:--shedding of blood.
BiblicalUsage: haimatekchysía is the word for shedding of blood. In Hebrews 9:22, the text says "And almost all things are by the law purged with blood."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, haimatekchysía means shedding of blood, and I leave it at that.
